pole_plus.label: Near-certain continuation in new text: fires where the next token is almost fixed by earlier context, most often the next piece of a rare word, name or code identifier already used in the document (copying from context), or the completion of an established pattern; ignores verbatim repeats of long spans; needs long context

pole_minus.label: No label survived. Best description (correlate only): tokens inside the second or contrasted member of a comparison, parallel or concession (e.g. the decimal in 'compared to the UK's 5.1%'); deleting the contrast words does not reduce activation

rejected_labels: + long-range re-mention of an entity introduced earlier (test 043a: 0/8, AUROC 0.41)
+ induction / verbatim copying of an earlier span (250-token verbatim repeats: 0.13 -> 0.15)
+ pure low next-token entropy (only 0.035% of entropy<0.3 tokens fire; steering raises entropy)
- counterpart slot of a comparison/concession (test 3f18: median 0.194, failed; cue deletion no effect beyond control)
- second, contrasted member of a contrast/parallel structure (test 6639: median 0.142, AUROC 0.79, failed)
